> [!NOTE]
> **Safety Reminder**:
> Do **NOT** attach database files, `.torrent` files, magnet link datasets, cookies, session credentials, or copyrighted media with your feature request.

## Problem Description
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the feature should behave.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workflows, or features you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, UI wireframes, or non-copyrighted mockups here.
